task.domain: Games adaptation of HaNoRec hit-1 binary preference
task.candidate_source: frozen SASRec top-M candidates; target never inserted

llamafactory.note: The pinned HaNoRec requirement exposes a package version but no source commit. The corrected Games runner ports and tests the observable HaNoRec trainer contract; it does not claim byte-identical LLaMA-Factory internals.

dpo.reference: frozen post-SFT adapter, no DPO adapter

controls.shuffle: fixed-point-free frequency-stratified item bijection built from training rows only
controls.constant_hardness: validation-only mean-matched diagnostic; not a primary test arm

smoke.purpose: correctness and measured resource smoke only

invariants: training pair and hardness hashes do not change when held-out targets/candidates/images change
negative is not target, observed history, or train-known future item
shuffle is a bijection and has no fixed points
global responsiveness batch has at least three examples
only the fresh DPO adapter changes during DPO
SFT-only reference is invariant to DPO updates and NoDO noise
partial or missing stages cannot be labelled COMPLETE
source/config/data/parent hashes are persisted and checked

statistics.training_seed_uncertainty: report individual seeds and spread; bootstrap is conditional on fitted seed models
